bio.text: Arlene Beckles serves in the Georgia House of Representatives and, according to her legislative biography, is the first Barbadian to go to the Georgia General Assembly.
She is originally from Barbados, spent 18 years in New York, and moved to Norcross, Georgia, in 2003.

She served on the Norcross City Council from 2021 to 2024, holds a doctorate in Organizational Leadership, and, according to her legislative biography, is a lead cybersecurity and information security project manager.
